title: Adapter descriptor
description: What `rhythm connect <name>` asks and writes for one adapter, and what `rhythm doctor` checks. One file per adapter: contracts/adapters/<name>.json.

name.description: Matches adapters.<name> in rhythm.yaml and IAdapter.Name.

summary.description: One line shown by `rhythm connect` with no arguments.

unofficial.description: True when it relies on an undocumented vendor interface.

profile.description: Compose profile of its own container(s), if any; `rhythm connect` adds it to COMPOSE_PROFILES.

docs.description: Repo path of its user doc: accounts and keys to set up outside Rhythm first.

pattern.description: A regular expression (anchored with ^ and $) an answer must match; for a list, each item. `rhythm doctor` does not take a value of this form for a leaked secret.

purpose.description: File secrets/adapters/<name>_<purpose>; the engine reads it through AdapterSettings.SecretFile(purpose).

source.description: paste: hidden prompt; generate: random 32 bytes base64url; connect: written by the adapter's IAdapterConnect flow.

connect.description: True when the adapter implements IAdapterConnect for steps beyond these prompts (for example a browser consent).

harnessToken.description: True when its container calls /mcp with a harness token of its own, secrets/harness_<name>_token (`rhythm token create <name>`): `rhythm connect` wants the token first, `rhythm doctor` checks it.
